repo.description:

AgentFocusParams.description:
The additive request shape for `agent.focus`. Exactly one of `target` and
`agent_ref` must be present.

AgentReportParams.description:
Flattening filters unknown fields instead of rejecting them, so a typo
through the socket API would report success and record nothing. The payload
is kept whole and deserialized in one step to keep both paths strict.

timeout_ms.description: Startup timeout in milliseconds. Values must be greater than 3000 and at most 300000.

forwarded.description:
Receiver-only marker. The receiving server rejects false and never
forwards this method, which bounds routing to one hop.

loop_id.description:
Optional during the receipt-schema migration. When omitted, the API
returns every observed run; when present, records with loop identity
are filtered to this id.

completion.description: Explicit task completion from the authoritative final report.

external_wait.description: Registered external dependency with a wake mechanism.

parse_status.description: Whether the adapter parsed an authoritative closing report.

settle_ready.description: Both closing-block settlement markers were present in the final-message tail.

workers_unknown.description: A previously reported worker disappeared without terminal evidence.

work_title_long_brief.description: Whether this prompt is long enough to establish a new work topic.

PaneSnoozeParams.description: Exactly one of `duration_s` and `snoozed_until` must be present.

duration_s.description: Relative duration in seconds. The server limits it to seven days.

snoozed_until.description: Absolute future deadline, in UNIX seconds. The server limits it to seven days.

focus.description:
Opt in to moving the session focus to the new plugin pane. Defaults to
false so an automated open never yanks the human's cursor. Placements
that exist to surface (`popup`, `overlay`, `zoomed`) surface regardless,
so this only affects background `split` and `tab` opens.

oneOf.description: Outer popup size in terminal cells, including the border.
Outer popup size as a percentage of the terminal area, for example 80%.

label.description: Absent clears the manual name so the tab falls back to its derived label.

WorkspaceBindParams.description: Bind a workspace to the repository whose work it collects.

reconcile.description:
Route matching panes that already exist into this workspace. Never
takes focus, and never moves the pane the human is focused in.

repo.description:
`owner/repo`, a GitHub URL, or a git remote URL. `None` clears the
binding.

source_workspace_id.description: Workspace whose focused pane supplies the `follow` cwd policy.

AgentRef.description: Cross-host identity for a pane-backed agent or windowless run.

pane_id.description:
Known limit: a binding is scoped to the host, not to the server that
issued the pane id. Pane ids restart at 1 in every server process, so two
named servers on one host both own `w1:p1` and an item bound in one can
report the other's column. Naming the server needs an identity that
survives restart with the panes it describes, which the sync work owns
along with binding identity across machines.

warnings.description:
Warnings collected at link time or on registry load (e.g. unknown event names,
missing manifest file). Non-fatal — the entry is kept and surfaced by plugin.list.

LoopFindingInfo.description:
One pending aloop finding (MAT-159 SCH1), as read from the producer host's
`~/.agents/aloop/findings` store.

settled_at.description: Unix seconds when the server moved this pane out of active work.

PaneLinkRegion.description: Inclusive display-cell columns on a pane's current viewport.

focused_pane_id.description:
Focused pane of the destination tab layout, not the session's focused
pane. A move made without `focus: true` leaves the session focus where
the user left it; read `session.snapshot.focused_pane_id` for that.
